demos.text: How many LEGO sets released in 2022 belong to the theme 'Super Heroes DC' or to any of its sub-themes?

queries.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.set_num)
FROM sets s
JOIN themes t ON s.theme_id = t.id
WHERE s.year = 2022
  AND (t.name = 'Super Heroes DC'
       OR t.id IN (
           WITH RECURSIVE subthemes AS (
               SELECT id
               FROM themes
               WHERE name = 'Super Heroes DC'
               UNION ALL
               SELECT c.id
               FROM themes c
               JOIN subthemes p ON c.parent_id = p.id
           )
           SELECT id FROM subthemes
       ));
queries.sql_u:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.set_num)
FROM sets s
JOIN themes t ON s.theme_id = t.id
WHERE s.year = 2022
  AND t.id IN (
      WITH RECURSIVE theme_tree AS (
          SELECT id
          FROM themes
          WHERE name = 'Super Heroes DC'
          UNION ALL
          SELECT th.id
          FROM themes th
          JOIN theme_tree tt ON th.parent_id = tt.id
      )
      SELECT id FROM theme_tree
  );
queries.cypher:
MATCH (t:Theme {name: 'Super Heroes DC'})
MATCH (sub:Theme)-[:SUBTHEME_OF*0..6]->(t)
MATCH (s:Set)-[:IN_THEME]->(sub)
WHERE s.year = 2022
RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT s) AS count;
queries.cypher_u:
MATCH (t:Theme {name: 'Super Heroes DC'})
MATCH (sub:Theme)-[:SUBTHEME_OF*0..6]->(t)
MATCH (s:Set)-[:IN_THEME]->(sub)
WHERE s.year = 2022
RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT s) AS num_sets;

demos.text: In which year was LEGO set 5007275-1 released?
How many parts in total (sum of quantities at all levels, including nested sets and minifigs) did version 1 of the inventory of LEGO set 7971-1 contain?

queries.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE inv AS (
    SELECT id FROM inventories WHERE set_num = '7971-1' AND version = 1
),
explode AS (
    SELECT ip.part_num, ip.quantity AS qty
    FROM inventory_parts ip
    JOIN inv ON ip.inventory_id = inv.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ip.part_num, ip.quantity * e.qty
    FROM explode e
    JOIN inventory_sets ins ON ins.set_num = e.part_num
    JOIN inventories i2 ON i2.set_num = ins.set_num
        AND i2.version = (SELECT MAX(version) FROM inventories WHERE set_num = ins.set_num)
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = i2.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
)
SELECT SUM(qty) AS total_parts FROM explode;
queries.sql_u:
WITH RECURSIVE exploded(parent_kind, parent_num, child_kind, child_num, qty) AS (
    -- Start with version 1 of set 7971-1's own inventory
    SELECT parent_kind, parent_num, child_kind, child_num, qty
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_kind = 'set'
      AND parent_num = '7971-1'
      AND version = 1
      AND is_spare = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recurse into nested sets and minifigs using their current inventory (highest version)
    SELECT u.parent_kind, u.parent_num, u.child_kind, u.child_num, e.qty * u.qty
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN u_composition u
      ON e.child_kind = u.parent_kind
     AND e.child_num = u.parent_num
     AND u.version = (
         SELECT MAX(version)
         FROM u_composition u2
         WHERE u2.parent_kind = u.parent_kind
           AND u2.parent_num = u.parent_num
     )
     AND u.is_spare = FALSE
)
SELECT SUM(qty)
FROM exploded
WHERE child_kind = 'part';
queries.cypher:
MATCH (s:Set {set_num: '7971-1'})-[:HAS_INVENTORY]->(inv:Inventory {version: 1})
MATCH (inv)-[r:HAS_PART]->(p:Part)
WHERE r.is_spare = false
RETURN SUM(r.qty) AS total_parts
queries.cypher_u:
MATCH (s:Set {set_num: '7971-1'})-[c:CONTAINS*1..6 (r, n | WHERE r.version = 1 AND r.is_spare = false)]->(p:Part)
RETURN sum(list_product(properties(rels(c), 'qty'))) AS total_parts

demos.text: How many parts in total (sum of quantities) does LEGO set 43109-1 contain at all levels, including the parts of its nested sets and minifigs?

queries.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE current_inventory AS (
    -- Get current inventory version for each set/fig
    SELECT id, set_num, version,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY set_num ORDER BY version DESC) as rn
    FROM inventories
),
current_set_inventory AS (
    -- Current inventory for set 43109-1
    SELECT i.id, i.set_num, i.version
    FROM inventories i
    WHERE i.set_num = '43109-1'
    ORDER BY i.version DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
exploded_contents AS (
    -- Base: direct parts from the set's current inventory (non-spare)
    SELECT 
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity as qty
    FROM current_set_inventory csi
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = csi.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Base: direct minifigs from the set's current inventory, expand their parts
    SELECT 
        mip.part_num,
        mip.color_id,
        im.quantity * mip.quantity as qty
    FROM current_set_inventory csi
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = csi.id
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = im.fig_num AND ci.rn = 1
    JOIN inventory_parts mip ON mip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE mip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: nested sets
    SELECT 
        ec.part_num,
        ec.color_id,
        iset.quantity * ec.qty as qty
    FROM current_set_inventory csi
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = csi.id
    JOIN exploded_contents ec ON 1=1
    -- Need to join with the nested set's inventory... this approach needs rethinking
),
-- Let's rebuild with proper recursive structure
set_parts AS (
    -- Start with set 43109-1's current inventory
    SELECT 
        '43109-1' as source_set,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ip.quantity as qty
    FROM current_set_inventory csi
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = csi.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Minifigs in the starting set
    SELECT 
        '43109-1' as source_set,
        mip.part_num,
        mip.color_id,
        im.quantity * mip.quantity as qty
    FROM current_set_inventory csi
    JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = csi.id
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = im.fig_num AND ci.rn = 1
    JOIN inventory_parts mip ON mip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE mip.is_spare = false
),
recursive_explode AS (
    -- Base: parts and minifig parts from set 43109-1
    SELECT 
        s.set_num as root_set,
        COALESCE(ip.part_num, mip.part_num) as part_num,
        COALESCE(ip.color_id, mip.color_id) as color_id,
        COALESCE(ip.quantity, im.quantity * mip.quantity) as qty,
        1 as level
    FROM sets s
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = s.set_num AND ci.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id AND ip.is_spare = false
    LEFT JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = ci.id
    LEFT JOIN current_inventory ci2 ON ci2.set_num = im.fig_num AND ci2.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN inventory_parts mip ON mip.inventory_id = ci2.id AND mip.is_spare = false
    WHERE s.set_num = '43109-1'
      AND (ip.part_num IS NOT NULL OR mip.part_num IS NOT NULL)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: nested sets
    SELECT 
        re.root_set,
        COALESCE(ip.part_num, mip.part_num) as part_num,
        COALESCE(ip.color_id, mip.color_id) as color_id,
        re.qty * COALESCE(ip.quantity, iset.quantity * mip.quantity) as qty,
        re.level + 1
    FROM recursive_explode re
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = re.root_set AND ci.rn = 1
    JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = ci.id
    JOIN current_inventory ci_nested ON ci_nested.set_num = iset.set_num AND ci_nested.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci_nested.id AND ip.is_spare = false
    LEFT JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = ci_nested.id
    LEFT JOIN current_inventory ci2 ON ci2.set_num = im.fig_num AND ci2.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN inventory_parts mip ON mip.inventory_id = ci2.id AND mip.is_spare = false
    WHERE (ip.part_num IS NOT NULL OR mip.part_num IS NOT NULL)
),
-- Simpler correct approach
all_parts AS (
    -- Start with set 43109-1, multiplier 1
    SELECT 
        '43109-1' as current_item,
        1 as multiplier,
        0 as depth
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Expand nested sets and minifigs
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(iset.set_num, im.fig_num) as current_item,
        ap.multiplier * COALESCE(iset.quantity, im.quantity) as multiplier,
        ap.depth + 1
    FROM all_parts ap
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = ap.current_item AND ci.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN inventory_sets iset ON iset.inventory_id = ci.id
    LEFT JOIN inventory_minifigs im ON im.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE iset.set_num IS NOT NULL OR im.fig_num IS NOT NULL
),
-- Get all parts from all expanded items
item_parts AS (
    SELECT 
        ap.current_item,
        ap.multiplier,
        ip.part_num,
        ip.color_id,
        ap.multiplier * ip.quantity as total_qty
    FROM all_parts ap
    JOIN current_inventory ci ON ci.set_num = ap.current_item AND ci.rn = 1
    JOIN inventory_parts ip ON ip.inventory_id = ci.id
    WHERE ip.is_spare = false
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_qty), 0) as total_parts
FROM item_parts
queries.sql_u:
WITH RECURSIVE exploded(parent_kind, parent_num, child_kind, child_num, qty) AS (
    -- Start with the current inventory of set 43109-1
    SELECT 
        uc.parent_kind,
        uc.parent_num,
        uc.child_kind,
        uc.child_num,
        uc.qty
    FROM u_composition uc
    WHERE uc.parent_kind = 'set'
      AND uc.parent_num = '43109-1'
      AND uc.version = (
          SELECT MAX(version)
          FROM u_composition
          WHERE parent_kind = 'set' AND parent_num = '43109-1'
      )
      AND uc.is_spare = FALSE

    UNION ALL

    -- Recurse into nested sets and minifigs using their current inventory
    SELECT 
        uc.parent_kind,
        uc.parent_num,
        uc.child_kind,
        uc.child_num,
        e.qty * uc.qty
    FROM u_composition uc
    JOIN exploded e
      ON (uc.parent_kind = 'set' AND e.child_kind = 'set' AND uc.parent_num = e.child_num)
      OR (uc.parent_kind = 'minifig' AND e.child_kind = 'minifig' AND uc.parent_num = e.child_num)
    WHERE uc.version = (
          SELECT MAX(version)
          FROM u_composition
          WHERE parent_kind = uc.parent_kind AND parent_num = uc.parent_num
      )
      AND uc.is_spare = FALSE
)
SELECT SUM(qty) AS total_parts
FROM exploded
WHERE child_kind = 'part';
queries.cypher:
MATCH (s:Set {set_num: '43109-1'})-[:HAS_INVENTORY]->(inv:Inventory)
WITH s, inv
ORDER BY inv.version DESC
LIMIT 1
WITH s, inv AS current_inv
MATCH (current_inv)-[r:HAS_PART]->(p:Part)
WHERE r.is_spare = false
WITH s, current_inv, sum(r.qty) AS direct_parts
OPTIONAL MATCH (current_inv)-[r2:CONTAINS_SET]->(nested:Set)
OPTIONAL MATCH (nested)-[:HAS_INVENTORY]->(nested_inv:Inventory)
WITH s, current_inv, direct_parts, nested, nested_inv, r2
ORDER BY nested_inv.version DESC
LIMIT 1
WITH s, current_inv, direct_parts, nested, r2, nested_inv AS nested_current_inv
OPTIONAL MATCH (nested_current_inv)-[r3:HAS_PART]->(np:Part)
WHERE r3.is_spare = false
WITH s, current_inv, direct_parts, sum(r2.qty * r3.qty) AS nested_parts
OPTIONAL MATCH (current_inv)-[r4:CONTAINS_MINIFIG]->(mf:Minifig)
OPTIONAL MATCH (mf)-[:HAS_INVENTORY]->(mf_inv:Inventory)
WITH s, current_inv, direct_parts, nested_parts, mf, mf_inv, r4
ORDER BY mf_inv.version DESC
LIMIT 1
WITH s, current_inv, direct_parts, nested_parts, r4, mf_inv AS mf_current_inv
OPTIONAL MATCH (mf_current_inv)-[r5:HAS_PART]->(mp:Part)
WHERE r5.is_spare = false
WITH s, direct_parts, nested_parts, sum(r4.qty * r5.qty) AS minifig_parts
RETURN direct_parts + coalesce(nested_parts, 0) + coalesce(minifig_parts, 0) AS total_parts
queries.cypher_u:
MATCH (s:Set {set_num: '43109-1'})
MATCH (s)-[e:CONTAINS*0..6]->(p:Part)
WHERE ALL(r IN rels(e) WHERE r.is_spare = false)
WITH s, e, p,
     CASE
       WHEN size(rels(e)) = 0 THEN 1
       ELSE list_product(properties(rels(e), 'qty'))
     END AS multiplier
RETURN SUM(multiplier) AS total_parts
